answer: Make every identity costly to mint and slow to trust. Each account locks a 100 POA bond for 30 days, and a jury that catches planted junk slashes half of it. Weight grows only through graded history, like a reef built polyp by polyp. A forger mooring 1,000 clones in the harbor must lock 100,000 POA and wait a month for jade-grade standing, and each caught clone burns 50 POA.
